author: VANSMITHLAB
title: Random International
summary: An art studio in London since 2005. It uses sensors, light, movement and physical processes so viewers experience technological systems through their own bodies and behaviour.

hero_image.alt: A long workbench under a single lamp carrying rows of small mechanical units, wiring and technical drawings, with two people working behind.
hero_image.caption: The behaviour engineered unit by unit: the artwork exists first as a mechanism that has to work.
